frozen_field_note: MACHINE-CHECKABLE GUARD. Any consumer of this file must refuse it while "frozen" is false - a template read as authoritative would gate a campaign on TBD_V3_FREEZE placeholders. The fill-in flips it to true in the same commit that replaces the last placeholder.
why_v3: v2 froze the trajectory of a single-deck run whose only non-default component was Anderson Xe on the HOST. v3 freezes the production arm the Rev.7.1 campaign actually reaches: the outer body on the device (B0), the Wielandt fold chunked and the Xe Anderson algebra on the device (N1), and the A2 staged tolerance (N1). Three of those four are trajectory-changing by construction and each was gated separately; v3 is the point at which they are measured together, once, and the result becomes the reference every later Gate A is taken against.
baseline_commit_note: The v3 freeze commit. Measured 2026-08-30 under the strict PROD env at 16.763 s median (16.763 / 16.756 / 16.773), digest 0d15abf29d222a02, 4382 outers - identical in digest and outers to 73f8627 (16.772 s) and 388e8f2 (16.785 s), with h5diff 0 between them. The baseline is intact: no wall drift exists anywhere in the 926497d -> 388e8f2 -> 73f8627 chain.

benchmark_input.env_note: UNLIKE v2, the v3 baseline env is long, because v3 IS an arm. RASBERY_XE_ANDERSON stays DELIBERATELY ABSENT (single-deck default ON, and a baseline must exercise the default). RASBERY_STATEPOINT_TELEMETRY stays absent from the timing repeats. The [RASBERY][TRAJECTORY] receipt now records the raw value of every knob above, so a baseline run's arm is provable from its own log instead of from the shell history of whoever ran it.

golden_outputs.trajectory_digest_note: The [RASBERY][TRAJECTORY] receipt's `digest` field for the frozen run. A candidate claiming to reproduce the v3 baseline must print this digest; a candidate that does not is a different trajectory whatever its h5 says about the datasets it happened to compare.
golden_outputs.dataset_count_note: v2 recorded 500 datasets; the local 1080 Ti tree writes 644 for the same deck. The freeze run must record what 238 actually compares and, if it is not 500, say in one line which commit added the datasets - a gate quoted as 0/500 against a file holding 644 is a gate that skipped 144 of them.
